controls.title: Ensure 'AuditDisabled' organizationally is set to 'False'
controls.description: Organisation-wide mailbox auditing must not be disabled.
controls.rationale: AuditDisabled set to true silently switches off mailbox auditing for every mailbox in the tenant.
controls.nistCategory: DE.AE-03 Information is correlated from multiple sources

assertions.failure: Organisation-wide mailbox auditing is disabled (AuditDisabled is {actual}); no mailbox activity is being recorded.

controls.title: Ensure mailbox auditing for E3 users is Enabled
controls.description: Every user mailbox must have AuditEnabled set with the CIS-recommended action sets.
controls.rationale: Per-mailbox auditing is what makes a business email compromise investigation possible.
controls.nistCategory: DE.AE-03 Information is correlated from multiple sources
controls.auditProcedure:
$MailAudit = Get-EXOMailbox -PropertySets Audit -ResultSize Unlimited | Select-Object UserPrincipalName, AuditEnabled, AuditAdmin, AuditDelegate, AuditOwner
$MailAudit | Export-Csv -Path C:\CISAuditSettings.csv -NoTypeInformation

audit.name: Find user mailboxes without auditing
audit.payload:
$mbx = @(Get-EXOMailbox | Where-Object { $_.RecipientTypeDetails -eq 'UserMailbox' })
[pscustomobject]@{ UserMailboxCount = $mbx.Count; MailboxesWithoutAudit = @($mbx | Where-Object { $_.AuditEnabled -ne $true } | ForEach-Object { $_.UserPrincipalName }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress

assertions.hint: Run Set-Mailbox -AuditEnabled $true -AuditLogAgeLimit 90 against every user mailbox.

remediation.name: Enable auditing on every user mailbox

controls.title: Ensure all forms of mail forwarding are blocked and/or disabled
controls.description: The outbound spam filter policy must block automatic external forwarding.
controls.rationale: Auto-forwarding rules are how an attacker exfiltrates mail quietly after a mailbox compromise.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users relying on auto-forwarding to personal addresses will lose it.

assertions.failure: Automatic external forwarding is set to {actual}; mail can be silently exfiltrated from a compromised mailbox.

remediation.name: Block automatic external forwarding
remediation.payload:
Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy -Identity Default -AutoForwardingMode Off
Get-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy | Select-Object Name, AutoForwardingMode | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous forwarding mode
rollback.payload:
Set-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy -Identity Default -AutoForwardingMode {{AutoForwardingMode}}
Get-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy | Select-Object Name, AutoForwardingMode | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure email from external senders is identified
controls.description: External sender identification must be enabled so inbound mail carries a visible tag.
controls.rationale: A visible external tag is the cheapest and most effective anti-impersonation cue available to users.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users will see an External tag on mail from outside the organisation.
controls.cisControl: CIS Control 9: Email and Web Browser Protections
controls.nistCategory: PR.AT-01 Personnel are provided awareness and training

audit.name: Read the external sender tag setting

assertions.failure: External sender identification is {actual}; inbound mail is not tagged as external.
These senders are exempt from the external tag: {actual}.
assertions.hint: Clear the external tag allow list unless there is a documented business reason for each entry.

remediation.name: Enable the external sender tag
remediation.payload:
Set-ExternalInOutlook -Enabled $true
Get-ExternalInOutlook | Select-Object Enabled, AllowList | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous external tag setting
rollback.payload:
Set-ExternalInOutlook -Enabled {{Enabled}}
Get-ExternalInOutlook | Select-Object Enabled, AllowList | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure modern authentication for Exchange Online is enabled
controls.description: OAuth2 client profile must be enabled on the organisation configuration.
controls.rationale: Modern authentication is a prerequisite for Conditional Access and MFA on Exchange workloads.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Older Outlook clients that only support basic authentication will stop connecting.
controls.nistCategory: PR.AA-03 Users and devices are authenticated

assertions.failure: Modern authentication for Exchange Online is {actual}; Conditional Access cannot be applied to these sessions.

rollback.name: Restore the previous modern authentication setting

controls.title: Ensure MailTips are enabled for end users
controls.description: All MailTips, including the external recipient tip and large audience threshold, must be enabled.
controls.rationale: MailTips warn users before they send to an external or unexpectedly large audience, preventing accidental disclosure.
controls.nistCategory: PR.AT-01 Personnel are provided awareness and training
controls.auditProcedure: Get-OrganizationConfig | Select-Object MailTipsAllTipsEnabled, MailTipsExternalRecipientsTipsEnabled, MailTipsGroupMetricsEnabled, MailTipsLargeAudienceThreshold

audit.name: Read the MailTips configuration
audit.payload: Get-OrganizationConfig | Select-Object MailTipsAllTipsEnabled, MailTipsExternalRecipientsTipsEnabled, MailTipsGroupMetricsEnabled, MailTipsLargeAudienceThreshold | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

assertions.failure: The external recipient MailTip is {actual}; users get no warning before mailing outside the organisation.
The large audience MailTip threshold is {actual}; CIS recommends no more than {expected}.

remediation.name: Enable all MailTips
remediation.payload:
Set-OrganizationConfig -MailTipsAllTipsEnabled $true -MailTipsExternalRecipientsTipsEnabled $true -MailTipsGroupMetricsEnabled $true -MailTipsLargeAudienceThreshold 25
Get-OrganizationConfig | Select-Object MailTipsAllTipsEnabled, MailTipsExternalRecipientsTipsEnabled, MailTipsGroupMetricsEnabled, MailTipsLargeAudienceThreshold | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous MailTips configuration
rollback.payload:
Set-OrganizationConfig -MailTipsAllTipsEnabled {{MailTipsAllTipsEnabled}} -MailTipsExternalRecipientsTipsEnabled {{MailTipsExternalRecipientsTipsEnabled}} -MailTipsGroupMetricsEnabled {{MailTipsGroupMetricsEnabled}} -MailTipsLargeAudienceThreshold {{MailTipsLargeAudienceThreshold}}
Get-OrganizationConfig | Select-Object MailTipsAllTipsEnabled, MailTipsExternalRecipientsTipsEnabled, MailTipsGroupMetricsEnabled, MailTipsLargeAudienceThreshold | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure additional storage providers are restricted in Outlook on the web
controls.description: Third-party storage providers must be unavailable in Outlook on the web.
controls.rationale: Consumer storage providers inside the mail client are an uncontrolled exfiltration channel.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users will not be able to attach files from third-party cloud storage in OWA.

audit.name: Read the OWA storage provider policy

assertions.failure: Third-party storage providers are available in Outlook on the web ({actual}).

remediation.name: Restrict third-party storage providers in OWA
remediation.payload:
Set-OwaMailboxPolicy -Identity OwaMailboxPolicy-Default -AdditionalStorageProvidersAvailable $false
Get-OwaMailboxPolicy | Select-Object Name, AdditionalStorageProvidersAvailable | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous OWA storage provider setting
rollback.payload:
Set-OwaMailboxPolicy -Identity OwaMailboxPolicy-Default -AdditionalStorageProvidersAvailable {{AdditionalStorageProvidersAvailable}}
Get-OwaMailboxPolicy | Select-Object Name, AdditionalStorageProvidersAvailable | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure SMTP AUTH is disabled
controls.description: SMTP client authentication must be disabled at the transport configuration level.
controls.rationale: SMTP AUTH is basic authentication under another name and cannot be protected by Conditional Access.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Devices and line-of-business applications relaying through SMTP AUTH will stop working until migrated.
controls.nistCategory: PR.AA-03 Users and devices are authenticated

audit.name: Read the SMTP AUTH transport setting

assertions.failure: SMTP AUTH is still enabled tenant-wide ({actual}); it accepts basic authentication that Conditional Access cannot see.
assertions.hint: Run Set-TransportConfig -SmtpClientAuthenticationDisabled $true after migrating any device that relays mail.

rollback.name: Restore the previous SMTP AUTH setting
